failure_boundary: The Open MPI runtime reported that it lacked Slurm PMI support and aborted before MPI_Init. This is a launcher integration failure, not a QE pw.x completion, SCF convergence result, numerical-convergence result, or magnetic observation.
preservation: The original three files are retained byte-for-byte. The original run-status JSON has a trailing comma because the first-generation shell script exited before writing its array closure; this defect is itself preserved as part of the recorded failed attempt.
